meta.title: DawaCheck — check your medicine
meta.description: Find a cheaper Jan Aushadhi generic, check batch safety alerts and fair prices, using public government data.

home.tagline: Check your medicine in seconds: cheaper generic, safety alerts, fair price.
home.scanBody: Take photos of the front and back
home.privacy: Your photos and location stay on your phone.
home.kendraBody: See the 3 nearest Kendras, with directions
home.aboutLink: About DawaCheck: data sources, accuracy and privacy

common.disclaimer: DawaCheck gives information from public government data. It is not medical advice. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist before changing any medicine.

scan.title: Scan your medicine strip
scan.stepFront: Step 1 of 3: front of the strip
scan.stepBack: Step 2 of 3: back of the strip
scan.frontHint: Photograph the side with the medicine name.
scan.backHint: Photograph the side with the batch number, expiry date and MRP.

scan.tip2: Tilt it slightly so the foil doesn't shine.
scan.tip3: Fill the photo with the strip and keep the text sharp.
scan.loadingModel: Getting the reader ready (first time only)…
scan.privacyPhoto: Photos are read on your phone and never uploaded.
scan.confirmIntro: Fix anything that is wrong. Fields marked "Please check" were hard to read.
scan.ingredientsHint: One per line, for example: Telmisartan 40 mg
scan.notRead: Not found. Type it if you can see it on the strip.
scan.error: Couldn't read this photo. Try again in better light, or type the name instead.
scan.demoAlert: Demo: strip with a quality alert
scan.demoNote: Demo: sample images made for testing, not photos of real packs. What is printed on them comes from public records: a brand's listed price, and a batch named in a CDSCO quality alert.
scan.stepStamp: Step 3 of 3 (optional): close-up of the stamp
scan.stampHint: Move close so the printed batch number, dates and MRP fill the photo. It is fine if the text is sideways. This helps a lot on shiny foil.
scan.matchError: Couldn't match right now. Please check your internet and try again.
scan.discontinuedNote: Our 2022 data lists this brand as no longer sold. The comparison is still for the ingredients on your strip.

scan.abstainNoCandidates: Couldn't find this name in our medicine list. Check the spelling, or ask your pharmacist.

scan.abstainStrength: This medicine comes in more than one strength. Which one is on your strip?
scan.abstainUnsure: Couldn't match confidently — please check with your pharmacist.
scan.pickFromThese: If your strip is one of these, choose it:
scan.evidenceNote: We compare what was read from your strip with our medicine list. We only show a medicine on our own when nothing disagrees and we are sure enough; otherwise we ask you.

about.title: About DawaCheck
about.intro: DawaCheck reads a medicine strip on your phone and checks it against public government data. This page lists where the data comes from, how well DawaCheck works, and what happens to your information.
about.sourcesIntro: DawaCheck refreshes these lists automatically on the 5th of every month. If a list changes too much at once, the refresh stops and the old list stays, so a broken download never replaces good data.
about.notRefreshed: Refresh date not available right now.
about.src_ja_products_name: Jan Aushadhi product and MRP list
about.src_ja_products_by: Pharmaceuticals & Medical Devices Bureau of India (PMBI), Government of India
about.src_kendras_use: Nearest Kendras. Where the official map position fails our checks, the address is located with OpenStreetMap's Nominatim instead, and the app says so.
about.src_cdsco_alerts_name: Drug alerts: Not of Standard Quality and spurious drugs
about.src_cdsco_alerts_use: Batch safety. An alert applies only to the batch that was tested.
about.src_cdsco_fdc_by: CDSCO (Gazette notifications), including court stays and revocations
about.src_nppa_name: Ceiling prices, orders S.O. 1575(E) and S.O. 1581(E), in force from 1 April 2026
about.src_nppa_use: Fair price. Ceiling prices exclude GST. Updated once a year, when NPPA publishes the April revision.
about.src_brands_by: Shudhanshu Singh, on Kaggle. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0. Snapshot of November 2022.
about.src_brands_use: Brand names, makers and ingredients, to recognise your medicine. Prices in it are from 2022, so DawaCheck asks you for the MRP on your strip. The brand tables DawaCheck builds from it are shared under the same licence.
about.src_osm_use: The map of Kendras, and locating some Kendra addresses.
about.resultsIntro: These numbers come from DawaCheck's own evaluation, which runs the same code as the app. A wrong answer counts as worse than no answer, so we report both.
about.devNote: Measured on {count} development photos, the ones used while improving DawaCheck, on {date}. This is a small set, so the numbers are rough; a separate frozen test set is kept for the final report.
about.finalNote: Measured on {count} test photos that were never looked at while building DawaCheck, on {date}.
about.matchIntro: {count} strips made from real brands with typical reading mistakes, never used while tuning DawaCheck. In 1 of 4 the brand is not in our list, so the right answer is “not sure”. Measured on {date}.
about.method_rerank: + checks ingredients, strength and form, always answers
about.matchNote: “Wrong answers” is the share of answers given that named the wrong medicine. Saying “not sure” keeps it low: you are then asked to pick from a short list or type the name. Made-up strips are easier than real photos, so expect real results to be lower.
about.readNote: “Plain OCR” is Tesseract on the untouched photo. DawaCheck first straightens the photo, evens out the light and removes foil glare. A field neither right nor wrong was left empty for you to fill in.
about.speed: Reading time per strip on a laptop: {median} s typical, {p95} s for the slowest 1 in 20. Phones are slower; the confirm screen shows the time on yours.
about.privacyPhotos: Your photos are read on your phone and never uploaded.
about.privacyLocation: Your location is used only on your phone, to sort Kendras by distance; it is never sent to DawaCheck. The phone downloads the Kendra list for its area (squares about 150 km wide), so at most that rough area can be seen. If you tap “Show on map”, map pictures for that area come from OpenStreetMap.
about.privacySent: When you tap “Find a cheaper generic”, the medicine details you confirmed (name, ingredients, batch number, MRP) go to DawaCheck's server to search the lists. They are not stored and not written to logs.
about.privacyNone: No accounts, no cookies, no ads, no analytics. The large-text setting is saved only in your browser.
about.privacyCode: The code is open, so anyone can check this:
about.safetyAdvice: DawaCheck gives information, not medical advice. It never tells you to stop or change a medicine: show the result to your pharmacist or doctor.
about.safetyGeneric: A generic is shown only when its ingredients, strengths, form and release type are exactly the same as your medicine's.
about.safetyUnsure: When DawaCheck is not sure, it says so instead of guessing.
about.safetyData: Government lists can be late or incomplete. “Nothing found” means not on the lists we checked, not a guarantee.
